component.name: Contrail
component.summary: Unofficial Telegram client for Linux phones

description.p: Contrail is an unofficial client that uses the Telegram API. It is built on the Telegram Desktop core and replaces its interface with an adaptive GTK4 and libadwaita one: a single column on a phone, the chat list and the chat side by side on a wider screen.
Contrail is not affiliated with or endorsed by Telegram. Group calls, stories, reactions, folders and multiple accounts are not available yet.
Groups with topics: a group opens its list of topics, and messages can be read and written in each topic. Notifications and links to a message in a topic open that topic.

The first release: packages for x86_64 and ARM64 as DEB, RPM, AppImage and Flatpak. Notifications and incoming calls also while the window is closed, calls answered from the lock screen with the phone's ringtone, a choice of where a call is heard, and messages marked as read when a chat is opened.
First preview packages: an ARM64 Debian package for Linux phones and an x86_64 AppImage.
